exposure: Cytokine levels (IFN-g, IL-10, IL-12p70, IL-13, IL-1b, IL-2, IL-4, IL-6, IL-8, TNF-a)
cohort: A total of 46 preterm infants born at gestational age <= 32 weeks were recruited, consisting of 14 infants in the BPD group and 32 in the control group.
finding: Multivariate logistic regression analysis identified gestational age <30 weeks, birth weight <1000 g, PDA, longer mechanical ventilation, higher FeNO, IL-6, and IL-8 on Days 7-14, and IL-4, IL-6, IL-8, and TNF-a on Days 21-28 as high-risk factors for BPD, with IL-6 also contributing to BPD disease severity.
followup_time: Cytokines were measured on Days 1-3, Days 7-14, and Days 21-28 after birth; FeNO was measured when infants met discharge criteria.
birth_weight: Average birth weight was 1021g (BPD group) and 1489g (control group), with <1000g identified as a risk factor.
gest_age: All infants were born at gestational age <= 32 weeks, with averages of 27.5 weeks (BPD group) and 29.9 weeks (control group), and <30 weeks identified as a risk factor.
